meta.schema:
Node labels and properties:
  (:City:Place) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Comment:Message) {browserUsed: String, content: String, creationDate: DateTime, id: Long, length: Long, locationIP: String}
  (:Company:Organisation) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Continent:Place) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Country:Place) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Forum) {creationDate: DateTime, id: Long, title: String}
  (:Message:Post) {browserUsed: String, content: String, creationDate: DateTime, id: Long, imageFile: String, language: String, length: Long, locationIP: String}
  (:Organisation:University) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Person) {birthday: Date, browserUsed: String, creationDate: DateTime, email: StringArray, firstName: String, gender: String, id: Long, lastName: String, locationIP: String, speaks: StringArray}
  (:Tag) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:TagClass) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
Relationships:
  (:Place:Country)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Place:Continent)
  (:Place:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Organisation:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Organisation:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:City)
  (:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(:TagClass)
  (:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(:TagClass)
  (:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:City)
  (:Person)-[:KNOWS {creationDate}]->(:Person)
  (:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(:Tag)
  (:Person)-[:STUDY_AT {classYear}]->(:Organisation:University)
  (:Person)-[:WORK_AT {workFrom}]->(:Organisation:Company)
  (:Person)-[:LIKES {creationDate}]->(:Post:Message)
  (:Person)-[:LIKES {creationDate}]->(:Comment:Message)
  (:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(:Person)
  (:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER {joinDate}]->(:Person)
  (:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)
  (:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(:Post:Message)
  (:Post:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(:Person)
  (:Post:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)
  (:Post:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(:Person)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:REPLY_OF]->(:Post:Message)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:REPLY_OF]->(:Comment:Message)

results.question: Could you tell me which university John Ahmad is enrolled at?
results.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {firstName: 'John', lastName: 'Ahmad'})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:Organisation:University)
RETURN u
results.gold: MATCH (:Person {firstName: 'John', lastName: 'Ahmad'})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University) RETURN u.name

results.question: Which pals of Alfred Sorongo Leakey share the exact same hometown with Alfred Sorongo Leakey?
results.cypher:
MATCH (a:Person {firstName:"Alfred", lastName:"Leakey"})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:Place:City)
MATCH (a)-[:KNOWS]->(p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city)
WHERE p <> a
RETURN p.id, p.firstName, p.lastName
results.gold: MATCH (p:Person {firstName: 'Alfred Sorongo', lastName: 'Leakey'})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(f:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(p) RETURN DISTINCT f.firstName, f.lastName

results.question: Among everyone connected as a contact to Alec Cheng, who resides in the exact same municipal area as Alec Cheng?

MATCH (a:Person {firstName:'Alec', lastName:'Cheng'})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:Place:City)
MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city)
WHERE p <> a AND ((p)-[:KNOWS]->(a) OR (a)-[:KNOWS]->(p))
RETURN p
results.gold: MATCH (p:Person {firstName: 'Alec', lastName: 'Cheng'})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(f:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(p) RETURN DISTINCT f.firstName, f.lastName

results.question: What is the shortest distance in connection steps separating Ayesha Butt and Hồ Chí Loan?
results.cypher:
MATCH (p1:Person {firstName:'Ayesha', lastName:'Butt'}), (p2:Person {firstName:'Hồ', lastName:'Chí Loan'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((p1)-[*]-(p2))
RETURN length(p) AS distance
results.gold: MATCH (a:Person {firstName: 'Ayesha', lastName: 'Butt'}), (b:Person {firstName: 'Hồ Chí', lastName: 'Loan'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:KNOWS*]-(b)) RETURN length(p)

MATCH path = shortestPath((p1)-[:KNOWS*]-(p2))
RETURN length(path) AS hops
results.gold: MATCH (a:Person {firstName: 'Masao', lastName: 'Yamada'}), (b:Person {firstName: 'Lin', lastName: 'Zhu'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:KNOWS*]-(b)) RETURN length(p)

results.question: How many users enrolled in the community during the month of March in 2011?
results.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[h:HAS_MEMBER]->(:Forum)
WHERE h.joinDate >= datetime('2011-03-01T00:00:00') AND h.joinDate < datetime('2011-04-01T00:00:00')
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS userCount
results.gold: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.creationDate.year = 2011 AND p.creationDate.month = 3 RETURN count(p)

results.question: Could you report how many user profiles were registered in February of 2012?

WHERE p.creationDate >= datetime('2012-02-01T00:00:00')
  AND p.creationDate < datetime('2012-03-01T00:00:00')
RETURN count(p) AS registeredUsers
results.gold: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.creationDate.year = 2012 AND p.creationDate.month = 2 RETURN count(p)
